basis: Scope map 3.9 Must explain; ACSC/CISA OT principles (know who accesses OT data, segregate OT); SEP-MON-01 to 03.

slots.question: Which monitoring, logging and endpoint agents run on each host?
Where do the logs, events and telemetry go, which side opens the connection, and is the destination inside OT?
Which logs and records does the application itself produce (event, call and position records, recordings), and where are they kept?
Are log sources, retention and tamper protection defined, and is coverage verified across all vital hosts?
What monitoring visibility is lost when OT is isolated from IT?
